newsitem.title: UK: Saudi cuts July crude prices to Europe, US steady.
newsitem.headline: Saudi cuts July crude prices to Europe, US steady.

text.p: Saudi Arabia cut crude prices for European customers by 20 cents a barrel in July but left prices to the U.S. unchanged for most grades, traders said on Wednesday.
Saudi Arab Light for European customers will be priced at Dated Brent -$2.25 a barrel in July, down from -$2.05 in June.
Arab Heavy and Berri Extra Light will also fall by 20 cents a barrel to Dated Brent -$4.35 a barrel and -$1.35 a barrel respectively, traders said.
U.S. customers will pay WTI -$3.60 a barrel for Arab Light next month, unchanged from June. The price for Arab Heavy has also been left unchanged at WTI -$5.50 a barrel.
Berri Extra Light to the U.S. will be 10 cents cheaper at WTI -$2.80 a barrel, traders said.
Traders said they expected Arab Medium also to fall by 20 cents a barrel for European customers to Dated Brent -$3.55 a barrel but details could not be immediately confirmed.
Term lifters were also awaiting the price for Arab Medium to the U.S..
